m: Peri peri sauce: blitz the chillies, garlic, paprika, oregano, lemon juice, vinegar, sugar, a glug of oil and 1 tsp salt. Keep a few spoonfuls aside for serving.
Coat the chicken in the rest and marinate at least 20 minutes.
Chips: oven to 220°C. Cut potatoes into chips, toss with oil and salt, roast 35 to 40 minutes, turning once.
Slaw: shredded cabbage and grated carrot with mayo, a squeeze of lemon and salt.
Grill pan, BBQ or hot oven tray: cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes a side until charred and cooked through.
Serve with chips and slaw, and the extra sauce for the brave.
l: Chicken and slaw in a wrap, or over rice. Skip the chips.
g: Naturally gluten free. Check the mayo label.
